See the [pneumatic and hydraulic lubrication pumps](/c/pneumatic-lubrication-pumps) shelf for related equipment.

faqs.q: Which part numbers does the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) range include?
faqs.a: The range lists 3 part numbers plus versions configured to order from 111 order codes (TS30…). The TS30 carries up to 6 quarts and the TS33 20 quarts, which runs up to about 200 hours between fills.

faqs.q: How do I select from the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) range?
faqs.a: Check the air supply or the machine's hydraulic circuit, then the lubricant and reservoir: the listed options include Grease Plastic 5 LB, Grease Steel 5 LB, Oil Plastic 2.5 QT and Oil Plastic 6 QT. Choose the TS33 where a long interval between fills matters.

faqs.q: What pressure and output do the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) have?
faqs.a: Indicator assemblies are listed for 1,450 and 2,050 psi, and the disc kit row is rated 2650PSI. The listing gives reservoir sizes by order code rather than a single pressure figure.

faqs.q: What do I quote to order from the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) range?
faqs.a: Quote the Indus part number, for example IH-BD-10412OG (INDICATOR ASSEMBLY 2050 P.S.I.) or IH-BD-FT15423PKK (DISC KIT 10/PACK PINK 2650PSI), or the TS30… order code, which we confirm as a valid combination before quoting.

faqs.q: How do the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) compare with a similar range?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) are complete pumping stations with a reservoir, while the TB-D piston pumps are the air-operated pump element for small multi-line and progressive systems. See the [Bijur Delimon TB-D Pneumatic Piston Pumps](/p/bijur-delimon-tb-d-pneumatic-piston-pumps) for its own ratings.

faqs.q: What lubricants can the Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) be used with?
faqs.a: The Bijur Delimon TS30 and TS33 Lubrication Stations (Pneumatic and Hydraulic) take oil or grease. The listed reservoirs include T30S5AC Grease Steel 5 LB, T30P4BC Oil Plastic 2.5 QT and T32P4BC Oil Plastic 6 QT.
